rate_note: Gowans prices are AUD hammer. Silver USD 51.50/oz at 2026-11-06 (gold-api.com); AUD rate assumed 0.66 USD, unchecked. Pattern: sheets and bags of mixed Australian shillings at Gowans mostly hammer $40-$130 with one outlier at $475; melt about $250 suggests the 27 coins are worth roughly $120-250 unless a key date shows.

viewing_check: Check the dates on the top two rows (Coat of Arms): look for 1912-H, 1913, 1915-H, 1916-M, 1919-1925 in any grade, and 1932 or 1933 key-type dates, and any 1931 or 1936 dates. Photograph the date side of each. Confirm the 17 ram heads are 1946 or later (.500) and none is the 1945 type (sterling).
